intro: Ukrainian culture is famous for embroidered shirts, decorated Easter eggs, borscht and a tradition of poetry and song, and it has become a symbol of national resilience.

chapters.title: Folk art and food
text: The vyshyvanka, an embroidered shirt, is worn on holidays and as a symbol of national pride. At Easter, people decorate eggs called pysanky with intricate wax-resist patterns.
Borscht, a beetroot soup, is so important that UNESCO listed Ukrainian borscht cooking as heritage in urgent need of protection in 2022. Varenyky (dumplings) are another favourite.

chapters.title: Music and words
text: Taras Shevchenko is Ukraine's national poet. The Christmas song Carol of the Bells is based on Shchedryk, a Ukrainian folk chant arranged by Mykola Leontovych in 1916.
Ukraine has won Eurovision three times, most recently with Kalush Orchestra in 2022. The bandura, a many-stringed instrument, and the energetic hopak dance are national treasures.
